items.title: Welcome to Levi45 Community
items.summary: A new home for Enigma2 downloads, news and tutorials.
items.body:
Welcome! This website is a place to share Enigma2 resources and helpful information.

Check the Downloads section for files and Guides & Tutorials for step-by-step help. No registration is needed.

items.title: Before you update: back up your receiver
items.summary: A short checklist to follow before installing a new image or plugin.
items.body:
1. Confirm the exact receiver model and current image version.

2. Use your image's backup feature to save settings and a full backup where available.

3. Copy the backup to a USB drive or computer.

4. Read the release notes and confirm compatibility before installing.

5. Keep a recovery method available in case the update fails.
